sentence_stem: Even though she had studied all night,
full_sentence: Even though she had studied all night, she still failed the exam.
acceptable_variants: she still did not pass the test.

options.text: so she passed the exam easily.
options.why_wrong: This shows a result, not a contrast. 'Even though' signals an unexpected outcome, not an expected one.

options.text: she was tired in the morning.
options.why_wrong: This describes her state but does not complete the contrast expected after 'even though'.
This is unrelated to studying and does not contrast with the first part of the sentence.

explanation: After 'even though', the second clause must show an outcome that is unexpected given the first clause. Learners often choose a simple result clause here, but English needs a contrast.
translation: Mesmo que ela tivesse estudado a noite toda, ela ainda reprovou no exame.
